title: motion-showreel style spec (P/style.json)
description: The tone & manner of ONE reel, derived from its source material (never picked from presets). Written as a draft by tools/extract_style.py, refined by Claude, consumed by the runtime (env.style / env.palette), scenes, timing (sound.bpm), audio (sound.*), narration (narration.*) and capture (terminal.*). Pixel values assume a 1920x1080 frame. Unknown top-level keys are allowed for forward compatibility; consumers must ignore keys they do not know.

meta.description: Provenance of this file. Set draft to false once the spec has been reviewed; extract_style.py then never overwrites it without --force.

evidence.description: Path (relative to P) of the extraction log, normally build/style-extract.json; rationale strings cite its evidence ids (E1, E2, ...).

purpose.description: launch | pitch | paper | docs | tool | brand | portfolio | demo | explainer | general

hints.description: User hints given to the extractor (purpose, audience, lang, theme, narration).

source.description: What the style was derived from. Paths are relative to P (or ~-relative); never absolute user paths.

mood.description: 3-6 mood words that every scene should honour (e.g. playful, pastel, bouncy / precise, calm, credible).

rationale.description: One or two sentences per decision group, each pointing back to evidence in the material (evidence ids, file names, measured values).

palette.description: Colour roles as #RRGGBB. Contrast targets on bg: ink >= 7:1, ink2 >= 4.5:1, muted >= 4.5:1 (text roles), ok/warn/deny >= 3:1; line is decoration only. accent may be a fill colour below 3:1; use accentInk for text in the accent hue. Extra keys must also be #RRGGBB.

bg2.description: Second background: gradient end, alternate scene, sunken band.

muted.description: Labels, meta lines and disclaimers: small text, >= 4.5:1 on bg (use line for rules and grids).

deny.description: Blocked / error / negative data. Never rely on ok vs deny colour alone (pair with icons or words).

accentInk.description: Optional: accent hue adjusted to >= 4.5:1 on bg, for text.

onAccent.description: Optional: text colour on accent fills (>= 4.5:1 on accent).

paletteAlt.description: Optional: the opposite-theme palette (same roles) for scenes whose reel.config entry sets dark: true on a light reel, or dark: false on a dark reel. Measured from the material's other scheme when it has one (dark slides, prefers-color-scheme), else a sibling theme (e.g. Catppuccin Latte for Mocha), else derived.

fonts.description: CSS font-family stacks usable in canvas ctx.font and CSS. Put the material's own family first, then installed alternatives, then a generic family. Quote names that contain spaces.

display.description: Headlines, logo-like titles, giant kinetic words.

mono.description: Code, terminal lines, HUD labels, numbers in tables.

cjk.description: Korean/Japanese/Chinese text; matches narration.lang when it is a CJK language.

files.description: Font files the runtime loads and build.mjs subsets/embeds. Paths are relative to P (e.g. assets/fonts/Inter.woff2). Only list files whose licence allows embedding.

scale.description: Ascending font sizes in px at 1080p (modular scale). Body copy should not go below the third step; disclaimers may use the first.

tracking.description: Headline letter-spacing in em (engine track(): |v| <= 0.15 is em, larger values are px).

trackingLabel.description: Optional: letter-spacing in em for small uppercase labels, HUD tags and credits.

theme.description: Dominant stage. Scenes may still go dark for a climax (reel.config scenes[].dark).

baseline.description: Optional: baseline grid step in px.

hud.description: Show HUD chrome (project tag, step bar, scene tag).

y.description: Vertical centre of the caption block: <= 1 is a fraction of the frame height, otherwise px at 1080p.

radius.description: Optional: corner radius for cards/chips in px at 1080p.

pace.description: On-screen pace at the reel's BPM. Longer cuts never slow it down; they add bars.

spring.description: Defaults for engine spring(t, f, z): f = frequency in Hz, z = damping ratio (lower = bouncier).

overshoot.description: Back-easing overshoot s (0 = none, 1.70158 = classic outBack).

transitions.description: Preferred compositor transitions, best first. Keep flashes <= 3 per second.

characters.description: Mascot/character cutouts carry part of the story.

dataViz.description: Real data (counters, charts, point clouds) carries part of the story.

visualSources.description: Kinds of imagery to produce. 'vector' (code-drawn 2D) is always present; add others only when they serve the story.

typeReveal.description: Optional: preferred text reveals, best first (engine helpers kinetic, kinetic with pop, revealLine, scramble, typing caret).

bloom.description: Glow strength for neon accents (0 on light stages).

bpm.description: Tempo of every cut (reel.config bpm may override).

mode.description: extract_style.py writes major or minor; audio/arrange.py also plays the church modes.

preset.description: Instrument family for audio/synth.py (a sound palette, not a visual style).

instruments.description: audio/synth.py instrument names (python3 audio/synth.py list): pad strings piano epiano pluck arp marimba bell glass saw-pluck bass saw-bass sub stab lead kick clap snare rim hats shaker toms crackle. Include at least one bed (pad, strings, epiano or piano).

energy.description: 0..1 per music part. extract_style.py writes the object form.

recommended.description: Whether a narrated cut serves this material (explainers, papers, docs). The user decides; captions follow narration.

voice.description: Gemini prebuilt voice name (Puck, Kore, Charon, Aoede, Fenrir, Laomedeia, Achird, Sulafat, Iapetus, Sadaltager, Schedar, Algieba, Achernar, ...).

styleTag.description: Bracket audio tag that shapes delivery without being read aloud, e.g. [fast, energetic].

lang.description: BCP-47 (ko-KR, en-US, ja-JP); compare by primary subtag.

terminal.description: Optional: palette for terminal/CLI captures (runtime/term.js). Present when the material names or ships a terminal theme, or plans terminal/cli visuals.

ansi.description: ANSI 0-15: black red green yellow blue magenta cyan white, then the bright variants.

swatches.description: Optional: measured colours of the material (merged across sources), for decoration beyond the roles.

review.description: Fields that need human/Claude judgment, with the reason and the extractor's confidence.

cssColor.description: Any CSS colour (hex, rgb(), rgba(), hsl()).

fontStack.description: CSS font-family list ending with a generic family, e.g. "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif.
